title: 混凝土重力壩分塊澆築~Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction
focus: 澆塊熱歷程、層面品質與重力壩荷載路徑~Block thermal histories, lift-joint quality and gravity-dam load paths
summary: 本課以混凝土重力壩分塊澆築為入口，深入澆塊熱歷程、層面品質與重力壩荷載路徑。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction as its entry point, this course examines block thermal histories, lift-joint quality and gravity-dam load paths. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K). Adiabatic rise is 18.75 K, not the actual peak temperature. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h. Placement requires eight hours, or 9.5 h with a 1.5 h outage, excluding local compaction and coverage sequence. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters.
history: 重力壩分塊澆築把供料、溫控和接縫安排結合，讓施工階段留下的初始條件成為長期結構行為的一部分。美國墾務局出版重力壩設計專書，提供施工與結構整合背景。 美國工兵團重力壩設計手冊出版，整理荷載與穩定分析。 碾壓混凝土手冊出版，提供不同大體積澆築方法的比較。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~Block-by-block gravity-dam construction connects supply, temperature control and joints, making construction initial conditions part of the long-term structural response. Reclamation publishes Design of Gravity Dams, providing integrated construction and structural context. USACE publishes Gravity Dam Design guidance for loading and stability analysis. The RCC manual is published, enabling comparison with other mass-concrete placement methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 絕熱溫升與膠結材~Adiabatic rise and binder heat
units.title: 絕熱溫升與膠結材~Adiabatic rise and binder heat
units.mechanism: 大體積混凝土內部散熱慢，膠結材水化熱會累積。絕熱溫升把放熱量和材料熱容量連結，但真實澆塊還有表面交換、骨材溫度與時間效應。 假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。 把最終總放熱瞬間施加會錯估早期峰值，忽略表面散熱則會過度保守或失去梯度資訊。相同膠結材用量也不保證不同配方具有相同放熱速率。~Heat accumulates inside mass concrete because dissipation is slow. Adiabatic rise links binder heat to material heat capacity, while actual blocks also exchange heat at surfaces and depend on aggregate temperature and time. Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K). Adiabatic rise is 18.75 K, not the actual peak temperature. Applying ultimate heat instantly misstates early peaks, while neglecting surface loss removes gradient information. Equal binder content also does not guarantee equal heat-release rates across different cementitious formulations.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K). Adiabatic rise is 18.75 K, not the actual peak temperature.
units.verify: 以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。以初始骨材溫度獨立檢查入倉混凝土熱量。~Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions. Compare block-core and surface temperatures, verify initial conditions by energy balance, and list formwork, air-temperature and cooling boundaries separately. Independently check placed-concrete initial heat against measured aggregate temperature.
units.failure: 把最終總放熱瞬間施加會錯估早期峰值，忽略表面散熱則會過度保守或失去梯度資訊。相同膠結材用量也不保證不同配方具有相同放熱速率。~Applying ultimate heat instantly misstates early peaks, while neglecting surface loss removes gradient information. Equal binder content also does not guarantee equal heat-release rates across different cementitious formulations.
units.misconception: 絕熱溫升就是工地澆塊必定量到的最高溫度。~Adiabatic temperature rise is the highest temperature that every placed block must reach.
units.practice: 以絕熱溫升與膠結材編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for adiabatic rise and binder heat, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions. Compare block-core and surface temperatures, verify initial conditions by energy balance, and list formwork, air-temperature and cooling boundaries separately.

units.anchor: 澆置供應與冷縫風險~Placement supply and cold joints
units.title: 澆置供應與冷縫風險~Placement supply and cold joints
units.mechanism: 分塊澆築要求連續供料與有序覆蓋，供應率不足會延長新舊料接觸時間。總日產量達標不代表每一局部層面都在可接受條件下接續。 假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。 同一停機時間在不同溫度下會產生不同接縫狀態，盲目加水恢復工作性又會改變材料品質。若只補足少澆的方量，已形成的弱層不會自動消失。~Block placement needs continuous supply and orderly coverage. Insufficient delivery prolongs local intervals between layers, so meeting daily output does not establish acceptable continuity at every local interface. Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h. Placement requires eight hours, or 9.5 h with a 1.5 h outage, excluding local compaction and coverage sequence. The same interruption produces different interface states at different temperatures, and adding water to restore workability changes material quality. Making up missing volume does not automatically remove an already formed weak layer.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h. Placement requires eight hours, or 9.5 h with a 1.5 h outage, excluding local compaction and coverage sequence.
units.verify: 按位置記錄每批到達與覆蓋時間，對照氣溫、坍度與凝結資料；將供料停頓映射到實際層面，另以取芯或指定界面試驗檢查接續品質，而非只查總方量。追蹤最久停頓位置的層面實際凝結狀況。~Record delivery and covering times by location and compare temperature, workability and setting data. Map supply interruptions to actual interfaces, then examine joint quality with cores or specified interface tests rather than total volume alone. Track actual setting condition at the interface with the longest interruption.
units.failure: 同一停機時間在不同溫度下會產生不同接縫狀態，盲目加水恢復工作性又會改變材料品質。若只補足少澆的方量，已形成的弱層不會自動消失。~The same interruption produces different interface states at different temperatures, and adding water to restore workability changes material quality. Making up missing volume does not automatically remove an already formed weak layer.
units.misconception: 只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。~Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam.
units.practice: 以澆置供應與冷縫風險編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按位置記錄每批到達與覆蓋時間，對照氣溫、坍度與凝結資料；將供料停頓映射到實際層面，另以取芯或指定界面試驗檢查接續品質，而非只查總方量。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for placement supply and cold joints, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record delivery and covering times by location and compare temperature, workability and setting data. Map supply interruptions to actual interfaces, then examine joint quality with cores or specified interface tests rather than total volume alone.

units.anchor: 層面剪力與有效正應力~Lift-joint shear and effective stress
units.title: 層面剪力與有效正應力~Lift-joint shear and effective stress
units.mechanism: 水平施工層面傳遞剪力，黏聚、摩擦與孔壓共同控制可動員阻力。層面清理和骨材嵌固影響黏結，不能用完整混凝土強度直接代表接縫。 假設層面面積100 m²、總正力30 MN、上浮10 MN、c=0.1 MPa、μ=0.6，阻力cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN；參數為假設峰值。 漿皮或污染使層面黏結降低，孔壓增加又削弱摩擦項。若在可能開裂的接縫仍無條件保留黏聚力，會高估滑動後阻力並掩蓋排水功能的重要性。~Horizontal lift joints transfer shear through cohesion and friction under effective normal stress. Cleaning and aggregate interlock affect bond, so intact-concrete strength cannot directly represent the interface. Assume interface area 100 m², normal force 30 MN, uplift 10 MN, c=0.1 MPa and μ=0.6. Resistance cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN, using assumed peak parameters. Laitance or contamination reduces bond, while pore pressure reduces friction. Retaining cohesion unconditionally after possible cracking overstates post-movement resistance and obscures the importance of drainage performance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設層面面積100 m²、總正力30 MN、上浮10 MN、c=0.1 MPa、μ=0.6，阻力cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN；參數為假設峰值。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume interface area 100 m², normal force 30 MN, uplift 10 MN, c=0.1 MPa and μ=0.6. Resistance cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN, using assumed peak parameters.
units.verify: 以層面取芯與剪切試驗核對黏結及粗糙度，將孔壓測站換算到相同層位；分列峰值與殘餘參數，檢查抗力式是否對應實際可用接觸面積。以滑移後試驗檢查是否仍可保留黏聚項。~Check bond and roughness with interface cores and shear testing, referring piezometers to the same lift. Separate peak and residual parameters and verify that the resistance formula uses the actual available contact area. Use post-slip testing to check whether retaining cohesion remains defensible.
units.failure: 漿皮或污染使層面黏結降低，孔壓增加又削弱摩擦項。若在可能開裂的接縫仍無條件保留黏聚力，會高估滑動後阻力並掩蓋排水功能的重要性。~Laitance or contamination reduces bond, while pore pressure reduces friction. Retaining cohesion unconditionally after possible cracking overstates post-movement resistance and obscures the importance of drainage performance.
units.misconception: 接縫剪力能力可以直接等同完整混凝土的強度。~A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength.
units.practice: 以層面剪力與有效正應力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以層面取芯與剪切試驗核對黏結及粗糙度，將孔壓測站換算到相同層位；分列峰值與殘餘參數，檢查抗力式是否對應實際可用接觸面積。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for lift-joint shear and effective stress, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check bond and roughness with interface cores and shear testing, referring piezometers to the same lift. Separate peak and residual parameters and verify that the resistance formula uses the actual available contact area.

units.anchor: 熱擴散與澆塊尺寸~Thermal diffusion and block dimensions
units.title: 熱擴散與澆塊尺寸~Thermal diffusion and block dimensions
units.mechanism: 熱擴散時間大致與傳熱距離平方成正比，澆塊尺度增加會讓中心維持高溫更久。這個尺度關係說明分塊原因，但不能給出精確冷卻完成時間。 假設熱擴散係數α=10⁻⁶ m²/s、特徵距離2 m，t=L²/α=4 million s=46.30 days；僅尺度估算，不是指定等待期。 用半厚或全厚當距離會造成四倍時間差，必須與邊界定義一致。後續澆層改變表面散熱條件，原本冷卻中的塊體可能再升溫，不能只外推初期曲線。~Thermal diffusion time scales approximately with the square of travel distance, so larger blocks retain core heat longer. This explains the value of subdivision without predicting an exact cooling-completion time. Assume diffusivity α=10⁻⁶ m²/s and characteristic distance 2 m. t=L²/α=4 million s=46.30 days, a scale estimate rather than a prescribed waiting period. Using half-thickness versus full thickness changes the time scale fourfold and must match boundary definitions. Later lifts alter heat loss and can reheat a cooling block, invalidating simple extrapolation of early records.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設熱擴散係數α=10⁻⁶ m²/s、特徵距離2 m，t=L²/α=4 million s=46.30 days；僅尺度估算，不是指定等待期。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume diffusivity α=10⁻⁶ m²/s and characteristic distance 2 m. t=L²/α=4 million s=46.30 days, a scale estimate rather than a prescribed waiting period.
units.verify: 比較不同深度溫度變化的相位與幅度，以實測材料導熱率和熱容量重建擴散係數；將冷卻管、表面邊界和新增澆層列入，檢查單一距離是否具代表性。比較半厚與全厚邊界定義對時間尺度的影響。~Compare temperature phase and amplitude at several depths and derive diffusivity from measured conductivity and heat capacity. Include cooling pipes, surface conditions and added lifts, testing whether one characteristic distance is representative. Compare half-thickness and full-thickness boundary definitions in the diffusion scale.
units.failure: 用半厚或全厚當距離會造成四倍時間差，必須與邊界定義一致。後續澆層改變表面散熱條件，原本冷卻中的塊體可能再升溫，不能只外推初期曲線。~Using half-thickness versus full thickness changes the time scale fourfold and must match boundary definitions. Later lifts alter heat loss and can reheat a cooling block, invalidating simple extrapolation of early records.
units.misconception: 澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。~Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time.
units.practice: 以熱擴散與澆塊尺寸編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較不同深度溫度變化的相位與幅度，以實測材料導熱率和熱容量重建擴散係數；將冷卻管、表面邊界和新增澆層列入，檢查單一距離是否具代表性。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thermal diffusion and block dimensions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare temperature phase and amplitude at several depths and derive diffusivity from measured conductivity and heat capacity. Include cooling pipes, surface conditions and added lifts, testing whether one characteristic distance is representative.

units.anchor: 冷卻水能量移除~Cooling-water heat removal
units.title: 冷卻水能量移除~Cooling-water heat removal
units.mechanism: 埋管冷卻以水流帶走熱量，進出口溫差與流量共同決定移熱率。大流量低溫差和小流量高溫差不能只憑其中一項判斷效果。 假設水流2 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、升溫5 K，移熱率41.8 kW；持續24 h移除3.61152 GJ，忽略流量溫差變化。 冷卻過快可能加大局部溫差和拉應力，不是移熱越多就越好。進出口感測器零點差也會在小溫差時造成大比例誤差，掩蓋實際冷卻不足。~Embedded cooling removes heat through water flow, with inlet-outlet temperature difference and flow jointly determining removal. Neither flow nor temperature rise alone establishes cooling performance. Assume water flow 2 kg/s, heat capacity 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and rise 5 K. Heat removal is 41.8 kW or 3.61152 GJ over 24 h at constant conditions. Excessively fast cooling increases local gradients and tension, so more heat removal is not always better. Sensor offset between inlet and outlet causes large relative errors at small differences and can conceal inadequate removal.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水流2 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、升溫5 K，移熱率41.8 kW；持續24 h移除3.61152 GJ，忽略流量溫差變化。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume water flow 2 kg/s, heat capacity 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and rise 5 K. Heat removal is 41.8 kW or 3.61152 GJ over 24 h at constant conditions.
units.verify: 同步量測各迴路進出口溫度和流量，積分移熱量與壩內溫度下降比較；檢查旁通、儀器偏差與管路漏水，避免只以泵流量代替真正穿過埋管的流量。以分迴路熱量總和檢查主回水量測的閉合。~Measure temperature and flow in each circuit synchronously and compare integrated removal with internal cooling. Check bypasses, instrument bias and leaks instead of using pump discharge as the flow through embedded pipes. Check main-return measurements against the sum of individual circuit heat removal.
units.failure: 冷卻過快可能加大局部溫差和拉應力，不是移熱越多就越好。進出口感測器零點差也會在小溫差時造成大比例誤差，掩蓋實際冷卻不足。~Excessively fast cooling increases local gradients and tension, so more heat removal is not always better. Sensor offset between inlet and outlet causes large relative errors at small differences and can conceal inadequate removal.
units.misconception: 只要冷卻水流量夠大，便能保證混凝土沒有溫差裂縫。~Sufficiently high cooling-water flow guarantees freedom from thermal-gradient cracking.
units.practice: 以冷卻水能量移除編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測各迴路進出口溫度和流量，積分移熱量與壩內溫度下降比較；檢查旁通、儀器偏差與管路漏水，避免只以泵流量代替真正穿過埋管的流量。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cooling-water heat removal, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure temperature and flow in each circuit synchronously and compare integrated removal with internal cooling. Check bypasses, instrument bias and leaks instead of using pump discharge as the flow through embedded pipes.

units.anchor: 成熟度與強度校正~Maturity and strength calibration
units.title: 成熟度與強度校正~Maturity and strength calibration
units.mechanism: 成熟度把時間和溫度整合為水化歷程指標，必須經同配比強度校正才可推論能力。不同膠結材或養護濕度會改變關係，不能把成熟度當直接強度。 假設Nurse-Saul基準溫度−10°C，混凝土20°C維持48 h，M=(20−(−10))×48=1440°C·h；未由此指定任何MPa。 高早期溫度可能改變後期強度發展，乾燥也可能中斷水化。若以其他配方成熟度曲線套用，會產生看似精確但缺乏材料依據的承載判讀。~Maturity combines time and temperature into a hydration-history index and needs same-mixture calibration before implying strength. Binder and curing moisture change the relationship, so maturity is not strength itself. Assume Nurse-Saul datum −10°C and concrete at 20°C for 48 h. M=(20−(−10))×48=1440°C·h, without assigning any strength in MPa. High early temperature can alter later strength development, and drying can interrupt hydration. Borrowing another mixture maturity curve creates apparently precise capacity estimates without the required material-specific evidence.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設Nurse-Saul基準溫度−10°C，混凝土20°C維持48 h，M=(20−(−10))×48=1440°C·h；未由此指定任何MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume Nurse-Saul datum −10°C and concrete at 20°C for 48 h. M=(20−(−10))×48=1440°C·h, without assigning any strength in MPa.
units.verify: 用現場溫度歷線積分而非平均氣溫，與同配比不同齡期試體建立關係；另核對濕養護和高溫歷程是否超出校正範圍，保留實際拉壓強度試驗。以保留試體的實測強度驗證成熟度推估。~Integrate concrete temperature histories rather than ambient averages and calibrate with same-mixture specimens of different ages. Check moisture curing and high-temperature exposure against the calibration range and retain direct tensile and compressive tests. Validate maturity-based estimates against directly measured strength of retained specimens.
units.failure: 高早期溫度可能改變後期強度發展，乾燥也可能中斷水化。若以其他配方成熟度曲線套用，會產生看似精確但缺乏材料依據的承載判讀。~High early temperature can alter later strength development, and drying can interrupt hydration. Borrowing another mixture maturity curve creates apparently precise capacity estimates without the required material-specific evidence.
units.misconception: 成熟度達到固定數字就代表所有混凝土具有同一強度。~A fixed maturity value means every concrete mixture has the same strength.
units.practice: 以成熟度與強度校正編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用現場溫度歷線積分而非平均氣溫，與同配比不同齡期試體建立關係；另核對濕養護和高溫歷程是否超出校正範圍，保留實際拉壓強度試驗。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for maturity and strength calibration, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate concrete temperature histories rather than ambient averages and calibrate with same-mixture specimens of different ages. Check moisture curing and high-temperature exposure against the calibration range and retain direct tensile and compressive tests.

units.anchor: 接縫開度與止水變形~Joint opening and waterstop deformation
units.title: 接縫開度與止水變形~Joint opening and waterstop deformation
units.mechanism: 澆塊收縮使接縫開度改變，止水需要承受法向張開及剪向錯動。只量接縫寬度無法代表三維變形，也不能以材料伸長率直接代替完整接頭性能。 假設有效收縮長20 m、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫12 K，自由收縮2.4 mm；忽略拘束與相鄰塊共同變形，非止水容許開度。 止水扭曲或接合不良可能在開度不大時漏水，混凝土蜂窩也會繞過完整止水。若只以接縫平均寬度判斷，會漏掉局部錯動與埋設缺陷。~Block contraction changes joint opening, while waterstops face both normal opening and shear offset. Width alone misses three-dimensional movement, and material elongation is not complete-joint performance. Assume effective contraction length 20 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.4 mm, excluding restraint and neighboring-block movement and not an allowable waterstop opening. Twisted or poorly joined waterstops may leak at small openings, while honeycombing bypasses an intact strip. Average joint width misses local shear offsets and defects in embedded placement.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效收縮長20 m、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫12 K，自由收縮2.4 mm；忽略拘束與相鄰塊共同變形，非止水容許開度。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective contraction length 20 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.4 mm, excluding restraint and neighboring-block movement and not an allowable waterstop opening.
units.verify: 使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。把接縫剪移與張開對止水的影響分列。~Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure. Check waterstop placement against tested joint geometry and use sectional leakage observations to locate preferential paths. Separate the effects of joint shear and opening on waterstop behavior.
units.failure: 止水扭曲或接合不良可能在開度不大時漏水，混凝土蜂窩也會繞過完整止水。若只以接縫平均寬度判斷，會漏掉局部錯動與埋設缺陷。~Twisted or poorly joined waterstops may leak at small openings, while honeycombing bypasses an intact strip. Average joint width misses local shear offsets and defects in embedded placement.
units.misconception: 接縫平均開度很小就能保證止水一定不會漏水。~A small mean joint opening guarantees that the waterstop cannot leak.
units.practice: 以接縫開度與止水變形編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for joint opening and waterstop deformation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure. Check waterstop placement against tested joint geometry and use sectional leakage observations to locate preferential paths.

units.anchor: 模板側壓與澆置狀態~Form pressure and placement state
units.title: 模板側壓與澆置狀態~Form pressure and placement state
units.mechanism: 新拌混凝土對模板的側壓取決於澆置速率、凝結與振動，短時間內可近似液體。把已硬化混凝土的側向性質拿來估新拌壓力會嚴重失真。 假設新拌混凝土容重24 kN/m³、液態有效高3 m，底壓72 kPa；每米寬合力γh²/2=108 kN/m，作靜水上界示例。 延緩凝結或重新振動可能延長液態壓力作用，局部供料堆高也會增加側壓。只按平均澆築高估算而忽略局部集中，會低估模板與拉桿需求。~Fresh-concrete form pressure depends on placing rate, setting and vibration and may initially approximate a liquid. Hardened-concrete lateral behavior cannot represent the fresh material pressure field. Assume fresh-concrete unit weight 24 kN/m³ and effective fluid height 3 m. Base pressure is 72 kPa and resultant per width is 108 kN/m, as a hydrostatic-bound example. Retarded setting or revibration can prolong fluid-like pressure, while local placement piles increase head. Average lift height can miss local concentrations and understate demand on formwork and ties.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新拌混凝土容重24 kN/m³、液態有效高3 m，底壓72 kPa；每米寬合力γh²/2=108 kN/m，作靜水上界示例。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fresh-concrete unit weight 24 kN/m³ and effective fluid height 3 m. Base pressure is 72 kPa and resultant per width is 108 kN/m, as a hydrostatic-bound example.
units.verify: 核對澆置速率、料溫與凝結試驗，將模板壓力計讀數按高度作圖；檢查振動期間峰值與拉桿反力，並確認壓力假設涵蓋實際材料工作性。檢查模板拉桿反力總和是否符合側壓積分。~Check placing rate, temperature and setting tests and plot measured form pressures by elevation. Examine vibration-related peaks and tie reactions, confirming that pressure assumptions cover the actual mixture workability. Check whether summed form-tie reactions match the integrated lateral pressure.
units.failure: 延緩凝結或重新振動可能延長液態壓力作用，局部供料堆高也會增加側壓。只按平均澆築高估算而忽略局部集中，會低估模板與拉桿需求。~Retarded setting or revibration can prolong fluid-like pressure, while local placement piles increase head. Average lift height can miss local concentrations and understate demand on formwork and ties.
units.misconception: 混凝土剛澆入就已完全自立，所以模板不承受液態側壓。~Freshly placed concrete is immediately self-supporting and exerts no fluid-like form pressure.
units.practice: 以模板側壓與澆置狀態編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對澆置速率、料溫與凝結試驗，將模板壓力計讀數按高度作圖；檢查振動期間峰值與拉桿反力，並確認壓力假設涵蓋實際材料工作性。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for form pressure and placement state, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check placing rate, temperature and setting tests and plot measured form pressures by elevation. Examine vibration-related peaks and tie reactions, confirming that pressure assumptions cover the actual mixture workability.

units.anchor: 上浮折減與抗滑~Uplift reduction and sliding
units.title: 上浮折減與抗滑~Uplift reduction and sliding
units.mechanism: 重力壩的自重提供摩擦抗滑，但基底上浮降低有效正向力。排水效果需由孔壓驗證，不能因設計有排水孔就自動採取最大折減。 假設每米壩段重量12 MN/m、上浮3 MN/m、μ=0.7、水平推力4 MN/m，純摩擦比μ(W−U)/H=1.575；未含黏聚與地震。 排水量變小可能代表堵塞而非更防水，孔壓升高會讓摩擦比降低。若把排水孔附近低壓當整個基底均值，會過度樂觀估計有效重量與抗滑能力。~Gravity-dam weight provides frictional resistance, but uplift reduces effective normal force. Drainage effectiveness requires pressure evidence rather than an automatic maximum reduction because drains appear on drawings. Assume per-metre weight 12 MN/m, uplift 3 MN/m, μ=0.7 and horizontal force 4 MN/m. Friction-only ratio μ(W−U)/H=1.575, excluding cohesion and earthquake loading. Lower drainage may indicate clogging rather than improved impermeability, and rising pressure lowers frictional reserve. Extrapolating low pressure beside drains across the whole base overstates effective weight and sliding resistance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每米壩段重量12 MN/m、上浮3 MN/m、μ=0.7、水平推力4 MN/m，純摩擦比μ(W−U)/H=1.575；未含黏聚與地震。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume per-metre weight 12 MN/m, uplift 3 MN/m, μ=0.7 and horizontal force 4 MN/m. Friction-only ratio μ(W−U)/H=1.575, excluding cohesion and earthquake loading.
units.verify: 沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。將堵塞情境下上浮分布另做整體力矩檢查。~Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes. Keep slip plane, material parameters and load combination consistent, then assess sensitivity to impaired drainage instead of checking one ratio alone. Check global moments separately using an uplift distribution representing blocked drains.
units.failure: 排水量變小可能代表堵塞而非更防水，孔壓升高會讓摩擦比降低。若把排水孔附近低壓當整個基底均值，會過度樂觀估計有效重量與抗滑能力。~Lower drainage may indicate clogging rather than improved impermeability, and rising pressure lowers frictional reserve. Extrapolating low pressure beside drains across the whole base overstates effective weight and sliding resistance.
units.misconception: 圖面有排水孔就能不量孔壓而忽略全部基底上浮。~Drains shown on drawings allow all foundation uplift to be ignored without pressure measurements.
units.practice: 以上浮折減與抗滑編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for uplift reduction and sliding, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes. Keep slip plane, material parameters and load combination consistent, then assess sensitivity to impaired drainage instead of checking one ratio alone.

units.anchor: 澆塊幾何與材料追溯~Block geometry and material traceability
units.title: 澆塊幾何與材料追溯~Block geometry and material traceability
units.mechanism: 分塊施工讓每一批混凝土對應空間位置，幾何方量與材料紀錄可互相驗證。超澆、孔洞和預留廊道會影響方量，不能用進料量直接當完成實體。 假設矩形澆塊20×15×2 m，扣除廊道30 m³，淨量570 m³；若供料590 m³，差20 m³須查損耗和幾何，不能直接稱空洞。 把運輸損耗或模板外擴誤判為內部空洞會導致錯誤調查，反過來總量吻合也可能掩蓋局部蜂窩。空間追溯能找出缺陷位置，總方量卻無法。~Block construction links concrete batches to spatial locations, enabling geometric and material records to cross-check. Overpour, voids and galleries affect volume, so delivered material is not automatically completed solid geometry. Assume block 20×15×2 m minus gallery 30 m³, giving net 570 m³. Delivery 590 m³ leaves a 20 m³ difference requiring geometry and loss checks, not an automatic void diagnosis. Transport loss or form bulging can be mistaken for voids, while matching total volume can conceal local honeycombing. Spatial traceability can locate defects, whereas aggregate quantity cannot resolve their distribution.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設矩形澆塊20×15×2 m，扣除廊道30 m³，淨量570 m³；若供料590 m³，差20 m³須查損耗和幾何，不能直接稱空洞。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block 20×15×2 m minus gallery 30 m³, giving net 570 m³. Delivery 590 m³ leaves a 20 m³ difference requiring geometry and loss checks, not an automatic void diagnosis.
units.verify: 把測量面、預留件和批次進料分別建帳，核對每車時間與澆築位置；以收方幾何、廢料紀錄和密度試驗做閉合，對不能解釋的差異要求獨立查證。對差異最大的批次回查供料和廢料原始憑據。~Maintain separate surveyed surfaces, embedded-volume and delivery records, matching batches to placement location. Close quantities using as-built geometry, waste records and density tests, requiring independent evidence for unexplained differences. Revisit original delivery and waste records for batches with the largest discrepancies.
units.failure: 把運輸損耗或模板外擴誤判為內部空洞會導致錯誤調查，反過來總量吻合也可能掩蓋局部蜂窩。空間追溯能找出缺陷位置，總方量卻無法。~Transport loss or form bulging can be mistaken for voids, while matching total volume can conceal local honeycombing. Spatial traceability can locate defects, whereas aggregate quantity cannot resolve their distribution.
units.misconception: 進料總方量與設計相符就能證明澆塊內完全沒有缺陷。~Matching delivered and design volume proves the entire block is defect-free.
units.practice: 以澆塊幾何與材料追溯編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把測量面、預留件和批次進料分別建帳，核對每車時間與澆築位置；以收方幾何、廢料紀錄和密度試驗做閉合，對不能解釋的差異要求獨立查證。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for block geometry and material traceability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Maintain separate surveyed surfaces, embedded-volume and delivery records, matching batches to placement location. Close quantities using as-built geometry, waste records and density tests, requiring independent evidence for unexplained differences.
